cases.prompt: Design and build a new marketing landing page for this product.
Do a substantial visual redesign of the existing settings screen so it stops looking templated.
Run a UI-quality pass over the onboarding flow and improve its visual direction.
Build a new analytics dashboard view from scratch with a coherent visual language.
Establish the typographic hierarchy and type scale for this new site.
Design the hero section for the new product homepage.
Give the new pricing page an intentional layout that is not three equal cards.
Design the empty and error states for the new project screen.
Add a purposeful page-load motion sequence to the new campaign page.
Turn this design brief into a concrete visual direction for the new UI.
Add a paginated REST endpoint for the orders resource.
Write a database migration that adds a nullable column and backfills it.
Fix the off-by-one error in the pagination cursor calculation.
Nudge the footer margin by 4px so it matches the spec.
Rename the isActive prop to isEnabled across these components.
Bump the build tooling to the latest minor version and fix the lockfile.
Profile and reduce the server response time for the search query.
Review this authentication token refresh change for security issues.
Split the CI test job into two parallel groups.
Fix the typo in the confirmation email body text.

quality_comparisons.objective_verifier: The deterministic fixture test verifies that a project that has not enabled frontend-design has no derived skill surface, and that enabling the canonical descriptor materializes exactly the marker generated from it for each supported provider.
Every backend or non-design control prompt in this fixture is labelled not-trigger, so a project that leaves the capability disabled receives no frontend-design context from it.
